hook.name: TupleOracleHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that maintains a TWAP oracle (truncated observations) and a liquidity book tracking liquidity distribution across tick buckets. It records collateralized debt positions via hookData on liquidity operations, overrides swap fees based on direction (zero fee for tuple→wrapped-native swaps, fixed LP_FEE otherwise), and donates wrapped-native fees back to LPs on qualifying swaps.
